title: Online Mentioning - VC Link through SMS to Ld. Advocates submitting online mentioning request
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: 21-01-2021

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
Date: 21-01-2021
Subject: Additional Features Added in the Online Mentioning
Platform - Auto SMS of VC Link to the Ld. Advocates /
Party-In-Person while receiving the online mentioning
request
With regard to the subject given above, this is to inform all concerned that, as
per guidance and directions of Honourable the Chief Justice Mr. Justice Vikram
Nath, the VC joining link for the concerned Bench, which is already being sent in
advance to the Ld. Advocates through email to the Ld. Advocates of the matters
listed; is now being sent in the Confirmation SMS sent in the morning to the Ld.
Advocates / Parties-In-Person submitting request for mentioning of a particular
matter before the concerned Bench.
Sd/-
REGISTRAR (SCMS & ICT)
